name: research-mcp
description: Academic literature research: Scopus search with hit counts and paging, citations, journal quartiles, open-access PDFs and CSV export.
long_description: Combines Scopus search with free, open scholarly APIs so you get abstracts, author metrics, citation networks, journal quartiles and open-access PDFs without needing institutional Scopus entitlements. Forward citations and reference lists come from OpenAlex, abstracts from CrossRef, open-access PDFs from Unpaywall. Every Scopus search reports the total hit count, the query as sent and the retrieval time for your search log; large result sets can be exported to a CSV or JSON file.

scopus_api_key.title: Scopus API key
scopus_api_key.description: Your Elsevier Scopus API key from dev.elsevier.com. Required for Scopus search and abstracts; the OpenAlex, CrossRef and Unpaywall tools work without it.

unpaywall_email.title: Contact email
unpaywall_email.description: A real email address. Unpaywall and OpenAlex require one for their polite pool and reject requests without it.

export_directory.title: Export folder
export_directory.description: Folder that export_scopus_results writes CSV/JSON files to, e.g. your literature folder. Leave empty to use export_dir from ~/.research-mcp/config.json or the research-mcp folder in your home directory.

tools.name: search_scopus
tools.description: Search Scopus by query string; returns the total hit count, search-log fields and one page of records.

tools.name: export_scopus_results
tools.description: Export a whole Scopus result set (up to 2000 hits) to a CSV or JSON file in the export folder.

tools.name: get_abstract_details
tools.description: Scopus metadata plus the abstract text from CrossRef.

tools.name: get_author_profile
tools.description: Author h-index, citations, ORCID and affiliations via OpenAlex.

tools.name: get_citing_papers
tools.description: Forward citations: papers that cite a given document.

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Backward citations: the works a paper cites.

tools.name: assess_relevance
tools.description: Screen papers against a stated research context.

tools.name: get_pdf_link
tools.description: Find an open-access PDF by DOI via Unpaywall.

tools.name: get_journal_metrics
tools.description: Journal quartile, CiteScore, SJR and SNIP for an ISSN.
